title: Escape
summary: Looming neurons trigger the giant fiber, and the giant fiber fires the jump.

stimuli.name: Looming neurons
stimuli.label: Fires the LC4 and LPLC2 eye cells that spot something swooping in.

silence.name: Looming neurons
silence.label: Stops the eye cells from reporting the swoop.

silence.name: Giant fiber
silence.label: Blocks the giant fiber, the fly’s fastest escape wire.

silence.name: Jump neurons
silence.label: Quiets the motor neurons that kick the middle legs.
